name: Tyre

related_people.name: Blastus
related_people.role: Herod's chamberlain, whose favor the people of this city sought for peace

related_people.name: Hiram
related_people.role: the bronze craftsman of this city brought to cast the temple's pillars

related_people.name: Hiram of Tyre
related_people.role: its king, who supplied cedar and craftsmen for David's and Solomon's building

description: A wealthy Phoenician port city whose king Hiram supplied cedar, craftsmen, and materials to David and Solomon for their building projects, including the temple, in a long friendly alliance (2 Samuel 5:11; 1 Kings 5:1-12). Paul's ship stopped there and he spent a week with Tyre's disciples on his final journey to Jerusalem (Acts 21:3-6).
